name: v1.1.4
body:
## What's Changed
* versions: bump versions for 1.1.3 August 2026 release by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3749
* Pr/cake portable topology by @RitzDaCat in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3755
* scx_mitosis: Mark init_task callback sleepable by @kkdwvd in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3753
* scx_mitosis: Prepare for subcell support by @kkdwvd in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3740
* scx_mitosis: Close the lost-wakeup window when disabling llc draining by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3760
* scx_utils, cid: SCX_OPS_TID_TO_TASK compat probe and cmask helpers by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3762
* scx_utils: Require CONFIG_FUNCTION_TRACER for scx_lib_init_probe() by @EricccTaiwan in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3758
* lib: Multi-instance sdt allocator and arena-backed per-cgroup data by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3761
* scx_pandemoniumv5.19.0: by @wllclngn in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3756
* scx_lavd: validate cached CPU pick against cpus_ptr on REENQ path by @1343503048 in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3748
* lib: Add scx_task/cgrp_free_rcu(), poor man's RCU deferred freeing by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3765
* scx_bpfland: Use SCX_ENQ_IMMED instead of cpu_release() by @EricccTaiwan in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3757
* common.bpf.h: default __scx_prolog_disables_migration to false by @multics69 in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3766
* scx_cake: select_cpu redesign — self-park mailboxes become default (2… by @RitzDaCat in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3767
* lib: Make scx_alloc_internal() a global function by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3768
* lib: cmask distribute helpers and caller-chosen allocator element alignment by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3770
* lib: Guard the arena NULL pages and watch BPF streams by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3771
* scx_mitosis: Three small cleanups by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3773
* lib/sdt_task: free task data without deleting task_storage by @multics69 in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3776
* scx_lavd: restrict direct dispatch to usable, uncongested CPUs by @multics69 in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3735
* scx_cosmos: Expand GPU locality hints to cgroup workloads by @nvax-r in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3772
* scx_mitosis: Fix solo-task placement staleness and test script robustness by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3774
* scx_nitosis: Add an experimental cid-form, arena-based fork of scx_mitosis by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3775
* Cargo: update libbpf to latest versions by @sirlucjan in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3751
* common.bpf.h: probe the BPF prolog on the cid-form attach path too by @devnexen in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3778
* scx_cosmos: Avoid redundant kicks after local dispatch by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3777
* scx_cosmos: Avoid redundant shared DSQ kicks by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3782
* scx_cosmos: Rework direct dispatch by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3783
* scx_cosmos: Re-introduce direct dispatch in ops.enqueue() by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3788
* scx_pandemoniumv5.20.0: by @wllclngn in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3785
* scx_cake 1.2.1 gaming regression hotfix by @RitzDaCat in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3786
* scx_cosmos: Contain tasks in the primary domain unless it is overloaded by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3789
* scx_cosmos: Replace polled CPU utilization with in-BPF accounting by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3790
* scheds/experimental: Introduce scx_cidland by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3784
* scx_mlfq 1.3.11-zero by @galpt in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3787
* scx_cidland: Rework virtual deadline accounting toward EEVDF by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3796
* scx_lavd: stop the bogus "no task data" errors from the futex hooks by @multics69 in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3781
* scx: bump rust edition to 2024 and rust version 1.91 by @sirlucjan in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3798
* scx_mitosis: Always use tracepoints for cgroup tracking by @dforsyth in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3769
* scx_bpfland: Remove experimental TIMELY mode by @galpt in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3801
* scx_cidland: Port fair/EEVDF to sched_ext by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3800
* scx_lavd: scale the compete window by online CPUs, not active ones by @multics69 in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3805
* scx_flow: Update to 4.2.24 by @galpt in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3804
* scx_flow: Keep Cargo.toml compatible with Rust 1.91 by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3808
* lib/cgroup_bw: manage only cpu.max-limited cgroups by @multics69 in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3754
* scx_lavd: fix and rate-limit the CPU performance target for schedutil governor by @multics69 in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3793
* scx: Shared helpers for the next scx_cidland series by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3807
* scx_cidland: Next round of fair/EEVDF fidelity changes by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3811
* Cargo: update libbpf to latest versions. by @sirlucjan in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3810
* scx_cidland: Move queues and task context to BPF arena by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3812
* scx_arena: Fall back to map-in-map grace periods where membarrier cannot wait by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3809
* scx_cidland: Cgroup scheduling and hierarchical load balancing by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3813
* scx_lavd: Fix the autopilot flag binding, torn task_ctx cache fills and futex return reads by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3815
* lib, scheds/include: cid and arena library prep for cid-form schedulers by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3814
* scx: bump rustfmt to 2024 edition by @sirlucjan in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3816
* scx_rustland_core: bump missing file to 2024 edition by @sirlucjan in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3818
* scx_arena: Retry arena page allocations and fail the allocation, not … by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3819
* scx_cargo: Work around libbpf's linker mishandling arena externs by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3820
* scx_cidland: Preemption and load-balance parity with fair.c by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3821
* scx_lavd: extend the overflow set by @multics69 in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3779
* lib/sdt_alloc: Reserve surplus slabs from concurrent refills by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3826
* scx_mitosis: Assorted fixes for fairness and vtime errors by @kkdwvd in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3795
* scx_nitosis: preserve arena pointer type in CID topology init by @liulangrenaaa in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3827
* scx_cake: improve CPU placement and tolerate obsolete launcher options by @RitzDaCat in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3797
* lib: TRAILING_OVERLAP() and arena running average operations by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3828
* scx_lavd: Drop the suggested_cpu_id clamp in init_task() by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3829
* Introduce scx_eevdf: a re-implementation of fair/EEVDF in sched_ext by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3825
* scx_lavd: Drop the unused conv_wall_to_invr() and get_cpuperf_cap() by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3832
* scheds/include: Make cmask_and(), cmask_or() and cmask_andnot() three-operand by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3834
* scx_mavd: Arena-native cid-form fork of scx_lavd by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3836
* Build BPF with -mcpu=v4 and move CI to clang 22 by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3837
* Add shared idle CID management library by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3835
* Probe kernel features at load and use the fetching arena atomics and BPF stream descriptors where available by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3839
* scx_arena: Size the per-CPU topology mask for every supported CPU by @devnexen in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3846
* lib/sdt_alloc, scx_rusty: reserve surplus arena pages from concurrent refills by @liulangrenaaa in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3841
* scx_arena: Type the topology node bitmap reference as struct scx_bitmap by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3851
* Cargo: update libbpf to latest versions. by @sirlucjan in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3853
* Add AGENTS.md for AI agents working in the tree by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3855
* Sync the shared headers and vmlinux.h with kernel sched_ext/for-7.4 by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3856
* scx_nitosis: Sync with mitosis through c9b90b3ad3d0 and add CONVERSION.md by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3857
* lib/cid: Split idle CID masks by topology segment by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3838
* scx_mavd: Sync with lavd through c9b90b3ad3d0 and document the procedure by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3858
* lib/cid: Add cluster idle scopes and splits by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3861
* lib: Introduce upstream libarena by @etsal in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3803
* Eevdf fidelity fixes by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3862
* scx_mitosis: Retry the other DSQ when the chosen head got away by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3864
* scx_nitosis: Sync with mitosis through 63f2014925f7 by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3865
* scx_lavd: fix neighbor migration never firing on non-SMT machines by @multics69 in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3847
* scx_mitosis: Clear the borrowed flag on every enqueue by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3867
* scx_nitosis: Sync with mitosis through 140ad0972582 by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3868
* scx_mitosis: Charge running time at every tick and sample the demand metrics over measured intervals by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3871
* scx_nitosis: Sync with mitosis through 42378f3ac13a by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3872
* scx_mavd: Sync with lavd through e7ed52c29856 by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3875
* scx: Add scx_spin_lock(), which aborts the scheduler on a failed acquire by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3869
* vmlinux: Update to sched_ext/for-next (a8acb152ff95) by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3874
* scx_nitosis: Delegate cells to sub-schedulers by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3873
* scx_mavd, scx_nitosis: Drop the __arena pointer tags by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3880
* scx_mavd: Make the neighbor-steal functions global by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3882
* Cargo: update dependencies to latest versions by @sirlucjan in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3885
* vmlinux: Update to sched_ext/for-next (a52cbf0bdbbf) merged with bpf/for-next (15b578b1715d) by @htejun in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3886
* scx_eevdf: Enable proxy execution support by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3888
* scx_eevdf: Bring wakeup preemption and placement closer to fair.c by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3889
* scx_eevdf: Bound a group's shares by the CPUs of its cpuset by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3891
* scx_pandemoniumv5.23.0: by @wllclngn in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3890
* scx_flow: update to 4.8.11 by @galpt in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3881
* scx_flow: update to 4.8.12 by @galpt in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3892
* scx_eevdf: Revert keeping over-served sleepers in the pack reference by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3894
* INSTALL.md: add Devario git package repositories for Arch by @sirlucjan in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3896
* scx_eevdf: Take a lone running member's vruntime as the pack reference by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3895
* scx_mitosis: Subcell splitting and demand weighted partitioning by @kkdwvd in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3817
* scx_flow: update to 4.8.14 by @galpt in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3897
* scx_lavd: add a completion-time estimator by @multics69 in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3850
* scx_lavd: completion-time-based migration on big.LITTLE by @multics69 in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3854
* scx_eevdf: Charge a blocking task's last run once by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3898
* scx_eevdf: Fix two more deviations from fair.c in the sleep and wakeup path by @arighi in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3899

## New Contributors
* @liulangrenaaa made their first contribution in https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/pull/3827

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sched-ext/scx/compare/v1.1.3...v1.1.4
